common_gotchas: Unlike other execute DATs, Parameter Execute DAT does not cook the watched node, reducing recursive update risk but also avoiding forced refresh.
onValueChange is called once per frame for changes; onValuesChanged batches complete changes at frame end.
Pulse callbacks only fire for pulse-type parameters pulsed by UI or Par.pulse(), not for every numeric transition.
Generated callbacks must avoid writing back to the same watched parameters without guards.
key_concepts: Runs callbacks when selected parameters on selected operators change.
Callback toggles cover single value changes, grouped value changes, pulses, expression changes, export changes, enable changes, and mode changes.
Custom and built-in toggles constrain whether custom or built-in parameters are monitored.
File and execute-location controls define the callback script source and execution context.
